title: Arena readiness and refusal tests

claims.text: settled asserts the named ready output is visible, the document linReady flag is true, aria-busy is false, and no progressbar is shown.

Refusal tests keep the real alert and settled status: no_benchmark and internal read failures show the actual error with a retry-panel action and zero mutation calls, and a malformed bench_status becomes invalid_response.

The Run action test requires a real bench_run tool and explicit actor, navigates to the detail route without dispatch, and the wire-shape test accepts declared, result and verdict payloads while rejecting tampered results.

triggers: real refusal alert replaced by render_error

decision.rule: Change here when the arena readiness assertions, refusal behavior, or Run-action gating tests need to change.
decision.failure: A ready screen never settles, a failed read hides its real error, or Run is offered without the tool or actor.

questions.q: Where does settled verify the arena screen readiness state?
Where should I change the expected refusal alert content for failed reads?
Where can I debug why the Run action appears without a real bench_run tool?
